title: MemoryCandidatesReviewResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "outcome": "promoted" | "fragmented" | "dropped", "record_ids": string[] }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.candidates.review (§7.15): CANDIDATE_CONSUMED, REVISION_CONFLICT, NOT_FOUND, NOT_AUTHORIZED, INVALID_INPUT, SPACE_FROZEN, SUBJECT_FENCED. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
